cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a hangar maintenance bay — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a modern ferry sundeck with distant harbour cranes in the evening breeze — she takes a quiet weekend crossing and watches a gull-shaped cloud; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — carries a camera by its grip at her side; an old stone chapel lit by candles — holds a small bouquet at chest height; a private far-future orbital apartment with a panoramic window and a hovering circular listening device — she stretches after switching on her favourite music; a Roman marble bath hall — standing; her crew cabin aboard a starship — sitting on the ground; a hilltop lookout over a wide valley — holds a cup in both hands; a desert oasis at golden hour — holds a water bottle at chest height; a castle kitchen with a great hearth — holds a folded cleaning cloth at chest height; a hanfu photo studio with costume racks — standing; a city rooftop with a water tank — standing; a small shop — standing close to a high shelf or line
